notes.title: Mineral: Anniversary
notes.content: [h1]1 Year of Mineral on PC![/h1][h2]8 Classic Levels: Reworked[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032082/83dde88c40a7752c16d6b25fd4295a227b2eaa4f.png"][/img][/p][p]With the Anniversary Update, we've picked our favourite 8 levels from the Core worlds and given them a rework, [/p][p]Set upon the Etheric Cliffs replay these levels, with the new objective of activating symbols liked to Mineral, Xitol and our community,[/p][p]Each level has 8 symbols to activate![/p][p][/p][h2]New Challenges, Collectables and Achievements[/h2][p]Discover and obtain 12 new collectables (4 Creator tokens and 8 Basalt Gems), these are scattered around the new Anniversary levels.[/p][p]We've also added 4 of each for Achievements and Challenges, see if you can unlock them all![/p][p][/p][h1][b]The Change List[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Fixes to Collectable System in-game and on menus[/p][/*][*][p]Improve stability[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of new Challenges[/p][/*][*][p]New Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes to player customisation[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Any issues you spot, please let us know through our [url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmineral-game.com%2Fsupport&snr=___"]Support Page[/url] we do our best to be as proactive with bugs as we can, but our team size is super small, and sometimes bugs slip through.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]🩵 - The Xitol Team![/p]

notes.title: Title Update 1.2
notes.content: [h1]Get Ready to Run![/h1][p]The first Free Content Pack for Mineral bringing 20 new levels and a new Run game mode.[/p][p]A new way to play Mineral. Reach the end of each run! Avoid the energy barriers! Use abilities to collect Portal and Etheric Gems to Escape![/p][p]Each Run level blends the traditional Mineral mechanics, with the pressure of moving energy barriers.[/p][p]Explore levels to discover Collectables and Secrets! Earn Challenges! Unlock new Ball Shells and Effects![/p][p][/p][h1]Updated Roadmap[/h1][p]We have now published an updated roadmap for Mineral, check it our [url="https://mineral-game.com/roadmap"]here[/url]![/p][p]The new roadmap details the content updates we have planned for this year in Mineral,[/p][p]Next up Anniversary on the 8th August, Mineral will be turning 1![/p][p][/p][h1]The Change List[/h1][list][*][p]Updated to Unreal Engine 5.6[/p][/*][*][p]Improve stability[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of Challenges[/p][/*][*][p]New Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]New Ball Cosmetics - Effects and Trails[/p][/*][*][p]New Game Mode![/p][/*][*][p]New Menu structures[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Any issues you spot, please let us know through our [url="steam://openurl_external/https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmineral-game.com%2Fsupport"]Support Page[/url] we do our best to be as proactive with bugs as we can, but our team size is super small, and sometimes bugs slip through.[/p][p][/p][p]🩵 - The Xitol Team![/p]

notes.title: Update to Version 1.1.7
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes
[/h2][h4][b]Anti Alias (AA) and Post Processing (PP) seem to unnecessarily increase GPU usage.[/b][/h4]
[b]Partial Fix |[/b] Some changes have been made to the Engine Rendering system and settings, we are still investigating further causes, but GPU usage is down after testing.

[h4][b]Some collectables were detected as unobtainable after a recent patch. Resolved | Changes to level construction and increased number of power-up charges where applicable.[/b][/h4]
[b]Resolved | [/b]Levels have been reworked/fixed to address these issues, we believe that some levels were changed by accident.

notes.title: Update to Version 1.1.4
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h4]Anti Alias (AA) and Post Processing (PP) seem to unnecessarily increase GPU usage.[/h4]
[b]Partial Fix[/b] | [i]Some changes have been made to the Engine Rendering system and settings, we are still investigating further causes, but GPU usage is down after testing.[/i]

[h4]Collectables Menu was showing additional collected items in overall counter.[/h4]
[b]Resolved[/b] | [i]Counter was incorrectly adding in values, will now show the correct number, aligning with the grid of unlocked collectables.[/i]

[h4]The “Overall Quality” section in graphic setting dose not remain as custom despite it being set to custom. And appears as the Anti Alias’ quality instead.[/h4]
[b]Resolved[/b] | [i]Changes to our menu structure and back-end have fixed this issue.[/i]

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[h4]New Customisation Menu[/h4]
As an early preview, and in response to some feedback we have added some initial Ball Shell Customisation to Mineral, this includes 4 new Default Shells, 5 Core World Shells, and 4 Unlockable Shells.

[h4]Crystals[/h4]
Gather Crystals as an in-game currency to obtain Unlockable Shells.

[h2]Updated[/h2]
[h4]Menu Structure System[/h4] 
The Menu structure system has been updated and improved in the background in response to bugs and to support new menus. Title Update 1.2 will bring a whole new menu design to support additional customisation and DLC packs.

[h4]Sound Sampling[/h4]
Audio sampling has been improved and optimised when packaging.

notes.title: Update to Version 1.1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Now with UE5...[/h1]
To coincide with the launch on Console, Mineral on Steam has been updated to Unreal Engine 5. This has included significant work overhauling the efficiency of features and doing our best to optimise a UE4 project for UE5. 

UE5 is more resource heavy with lighting, and so we are still addressing some minor quality changes that we aren't 100% happy with, but overall we like the improvements it has had to lighting and post-processing across all systems we have tested with.

It does also mean we have had to up the minimum and recommended specifications slightly, but from our analytics, all existing users meet these already.

[h1]Upcoming Work[/h1]
Mineral now running on UE5 now lays the work for Title Update 1.2 and beyond, which you can read more about on our[url=https://mineral-game.com/roadmap] Roadmap[/url].

We thank everyone who has bought, played, reviewed and supported Mineral so far, and 2025 is going to see Mineral grow in content and add more challenges, abilities, cosmetics, puzzle mechanics and levels.

[h1]The Change List[/h1]
[list]
[*]Update to Unreal Engine 5.5
[*]Improved lighting and stability from UE4 version
[*]Increase in minimum required specification 
[*]Reduction in time required for [REDACTED] achievements
[*]Reworking of background systems for efficiency
[/list]

Any issues you spot, please let us know through our [url=https://mineral-game.com/support]Support Page[/url] we do our best to be as proactive with bugs as we can, but our team size is super small, and sometimes bugs slip through.

🩵 - The Xitol Team!
